fields.value:
Data comprises 7 subjects (S01 up to S07).
For each subject 3 visual field mapping acquisitions were made using 3 different stimuli (LCR, SF and SF scot), each one comprises 6 runs of 192 functional images each. Each file in this data set represent one of these runs. 
 You can find more information about the stimuli design and data acquisition parameters here: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/758094v1.
